title: Meat Lasagna

items.item: diced tomatoes with basil, garlic, and oregano

instructions: In a large saucepan, combine the ground chuck, sausage, onion, and garlic. Cook over medium heat until the meat is browned and crumbled; drain.
Return the meat to the pan and add the oregano, basil, salt, and pepper. Add the tomatoes, tomato sauce, and paste. Bring to a boil, reduce the heat, and simmer 30-35 minutes.
Spoon ¼ of the sauce into the bottom of a 13x9x2-inch baking pan. Place 3 uncooked lasagna noodles on top of the sauce — do not overlap the noodles. Top with ¼ of the sauce and repeat the layers.
notes: No cheese appears in this recipe as written. Sausage appears in the prep but not in the ingredient list; tomato paste is mentioned in the prep but not listed in the ingredients either.
